newsitem.title: UK: BHP sees Lennox oilfield restart in June.
newsitem.headline: BHP sees Lennox oilfield restart in June.

text.p: Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP) said on Tuesday it planned to restart oil production from its Lennox oilfield west of Britain in early June.
Technical problems forced the field, which delivers crude ashore via the neighbouring Douglas platform, to close down after coming onstream in the middle of last year.
"We are still in the process of commissioning the pipeline which is going well. We anticipate production will re-start in early June," said a BHP spokesman.
At full capacity Lennox will pump some 30,000 bpd combined with 40,000 bpd of Douglas.
The company has tried to flush the pipeline carrying waxy Douglas crude to the terminal at Liverpool Bay.
It is installing pipeline heaters to treat the problem of wax build-up and hopes the less waxy Lennox stream will reduce wax content.
